title: Doppels Share
description: A one-use, expiring session that exposes a Capability form while its Recipe remains on the sharing host.

capabilityRevision.description: Exact source and schema digests for the public Capability snapshot.

capability.description: Public snapshot used to render and validate the input form.

recipe.description: Absent when the shared Capability will be fulfilled without a codified Recipe.

inputs.description: Optional prefilled Capability inputs for the public form. Validated against the Share capability snapshot; may be a partial set.

inputsLocked.description: When true, every key in inputs is immutable for the recipient (UI + server enforce).

artifactRetentionDays.description: Object Storage TTL for return artifacts on this Share. Copied from Recipe defaults.artifactRetentionDays (1, 7, 14, or 30). Default 7.
